commits_data.message:
E2AP:  Use gnbid to share RAN Function ID mappings

E2nodeConfigurationUpdate includes the gnb-id.  If it
matches a previous E2setupRequest with ranFunction mappings,
just use those.

Also show the tunnel address:port more nicely - could have copied
conversation settings at that point, but what we have should suffice.
